frequency_question: What proportion of expiring bilateral water-sharing treaties are renewed or extended before lapse?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral treaties governing shared river basins with fixed initial durations requiring explicit renewal/extension. Excludes multilateral conventions, non-binding declarations, and treaties with perpetual automatic renewal without review.
window: 30-year operational window leading up to expiration

cases.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements
1959 Nile Waters Agreement adjustments (Sudan-Egypt framework transitions)

coverage_note: 7 named; representing major documented transboundary water treaty renewal cycles over the past three decades.
known_gaps: Some bilateral arrangements in minor basins lack public documentation regarding expiration and renewal mechanics.
validity_reason: Macro-level geopolitical incentives for maintaining established water allocation frameworks remain stable over multi-decade horizons.
